evidence.description: Last Call Improv takes over Thursday nights at 9:30 PM for a wild, dynamic mix of styles and forms. Following right after the regular Thursday show, this late-night staple features a rotating lineup of performance troupes hand-picked from open submissions. The evening is anchored by Wanted Live , a featured headliner performing a TJ and Dave-style long-form improv set, where grounded, authentic human behavior drives the comedy. Whether you are looking for experimental forms or high-energy laughs, Last Call Improv offers an unpredictable, one-of-a-kind experience every single week.

events.summary: Experience "For Real," a live storytelling and improv show where real-life stories inspire unscripted comedy. This month features Michigan State Senator Mallory McMorrow sharing personal experiences that the improvisers will transform into hilarious scenes.

evidence.description: Real Stories. Real Improv. For Real is an improvised show inspired by real-life stories. Each month features a new guest who will share true stories from their life and experiences, then our cast of improvisers will use that as the starting point for unscripted comedy. Join us on November 19th with special guest Michigan State Senator, Mallory McMorrow!
